target_customer: Quantum hardware builders and research labs that need qubit calibration and control, plus developers who want to program quantum computers
problem: Engineers spend days or weeks tuning a quantum chip by hand to bring even two qubits to operating conditions, which blocks scaling.
business_model: B2B software for quantum hardware control (Control) and a natural language programming interface (Coda); pricing not public
product_category: AI software for quantum computer calibration and control

founders.name: Brandon Severin
founders.background_notes: Worked with IST Austria, Basel, UNSW and Diraq on AI for semiconductor qubit control during his PhD, per the YC page.

founders.name: Joel Pendleton
education: Left an ML and quantum computing PhD at Oxford
founders.background_notes: Employers and degree per the YC launch post summary.

technical_complexity.rationale: Automating qubit tuning on semiconductor and superconducting chips needs ML control research and access to real quantum hardware, and the founders had published research in the area.

defensibility.rationale: Deep domain expertise and hardware partnerships are hard to copy, but the market was small and larger control vendors could build similar tooling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A December 2024 Quantum Machines and Rigetti AI calibration demo shows incumbents moving into the wedge after the batch; no acquisition of Conductor Quantum was found.

market_need_then: Quantum hardware makers faced manual, slow calibration as qubit counts grew, a bottleneck the company's own materials describe; no independent spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses conductorquantum.com, a descriptive compound with the word Quantum added.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious, mission language such as quantum superintelligence; tagline Build Something Quantum.

branding.brand_signature: Three layer product naming: Conductor, Coda, Control.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found; naming is tidy but the word Conductor is shared with an unrelated coding agent startup that Meta acquired, which can confuse search.

outcome_analysis: Conductor Quantum is active with a small team and a clear research led wedge in AI control of quantum hardware. Its public traction is not documented beyond products named Coda and Control, and funding amounts are only seen in aggregators, so the outcome so far is early and unproven rather than a success or failure.
notes: Funding is unverified: aggregators list a $500K pre-seed (mid 2024, Pioneer Fund, Mergus Ventures), a $125K figure (July 2024) and a $3.5M seed (Dec 2024, from one job listing dataset). No press release or filing was found, so no round is recorded. Competitor search found only items dated after the batch (Dec 2024 onward), so the list is empty. Completeness pass 2026-11: a $500K seed (2024-05) is now recorded from StartupIntros (Extruct dates it 2024-06 and names Pioneer Fund and Mergus Ventures as leads). Conflicts not summed: TheCompanyCheck $125K (2024-07), CB Insights seed 2024-11-21, FastAIJobs $3.5M seed 2024-12 ($4M total). No press release.
